## What leaves the house
The transcript goes only to Ollama on this machine. The summary passes an outbound check (IDs, account and card numbers, dates of birth) and the approval form shows exactly what will be sent. After a person approves, Notion gets the summary and Google Calendar gets a private draft that doesn't block time. Both writes are keyed on the meeting ID, so retries never duplicate. Every step is logged to logs/household.jsonl. See docs/data-boundary.md.
